title: Mallworld: city portals*
content: The mallworld for me has alleyways or portals that make it easier to get in and out of US cities. I astral to these areas a lot. Probably because I am bored and trapped in texas. Want to be anywhere but here. It often looks like a glowing blue or grey (DC is green) cityscape with city landmarks or signs there as markers. The new york one is my favorite. Been obsessed since I was a kid. Always wanted to go but could never afford to even visit. So I see these areas a lot. Night before last, swear to god Zohran Mamdani was there. Crowd surfing and just playing in the astral. I say "wow, its really you." And I stuck around him to see why he was there. I was worried how many people also were watching and he reads my mind and says "don't worry, no one can hurt us here. Relax and have fun!" And he just starts hopping around and playing in the astral around the nyc mallworld cityscapes. It was wild and fun. Honestly kind of hate most politicians and leaders. Think they all sold their soul to the highest bidder long ago and are no longer human. But finding him literally playing with people in the astral mallworld. Pretty cool. And kind of the one thing someone could do to make me a fan. So if his PR team is hitting dreams, dang lol. My random dream story. Lmk if you all see anything similar.
